title: Blackstone Repositions Portfolio With Urbaser Deal And Larger Anthropic Stake
title_zh: Blackstone 通过 Urbaser 交易和更大的 Anthropic 股份重新定位投资组合
summary: Blackstone (NYSE:BX), alongside EQT, has agreed to acquire Spain based waste management company Urbaser, expanding its exposure to infrastructure and environmental services.
summary_zh: Blackstone（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BX）与 EQT 已同意收购西班牙废物管理公司 Urbaser，扩大其在基础设施和环境服务领域的业务。

title: Apollo Global Management (APO) Valuation Check After Q4 Beat Schroders Deal And EMEA Leadership Move
title_zh: 第四季度打败施罗德交易和欧洲、中东和非洲领导层变动后阿波罗全球管理公司 (APO) 的估值检查
summary: Apollo Global Management (APO) is in focus after a cluster of updates, including Q4 earnings that beat expectations, a new Schroders partnership in wealth and retirement products, and senior leadership changes in its EMEA business.
summary_zh: 阿波罗全球管理公司 (APO) 在一系列更新后成为焦点，包括第四季度收益超出预期、施罗德在财富和退休产品方面建立新的合作伙伴关系，以及其欧洲、中东和非洲业务的高级领导层变动。

title: Nuveen's $13.3B deal for 222-year-old Schroders bolsters its public-to-private offering
title_zh: Nuveen 以 13.3B 美元收购拥有 222 年历史的施罗德 (Schroders)，增强了其公私合一发行
summary: US asset manager Nuveen has agreed to take London-listed Schroders private at a £9.9 billion (about $13.3 billion) valuation, a deal that would create a $2.5 trillion investment giant and expand its public-to-private platform.
summary_zh: 美国资产管理公司 Nuveen 同意以 99 亿英镑（约合 133 亿美元）的估值将伦敦上市公司施罗德 (Schroders) 私有化，这笔交易将创建一个价值 2.5 万亿美元的投资巨头，并扩大其公私合作平台。

title: Carlyle’s flagship buyout funds gain after flurry of portfolio IPOs
title_zh: 凯雷旗舰收购基金在一系列投资组合首次公开募股后获利
summary: US private equity pioneer Carlyle Group says performance in its flagship buyout business has stabilised after taking a handful of investments...
summary_zh: 美国私募股权先驱凯雷集团表示，在进行了少量投资后，其旗舰收购业务的业绩已趋于稳定......

title: KKR & Co. CFO Sees Better 2026 Deal Outlook, Says Diversified Earnings Aren’t Priced In
title_zh: KKR & Co. 首席财务官认为 2026 年交易前景更好，表示多元化收益并未反映在定价中
summary: KKR & Co. Inc. (NYSE:KKR) CFO Rob Lewin said the firm is entering 2026 with improving visibility into deal activity, stronger fundraising momentum, and a more diversified earnings base that he believes is not fully reflected in the company’s share price.
summary_zh: KKR & Co. Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：KKR）首席财务官 Rob Lewin 表示，进入 2026 年，该公司交易活动的可见性不断提高，融资势头更加强劲，盈利基础更加多元化，他认为这些并没有完全反映在公司股价中。
